correctness.rationale: Checked the six original cubic-coordinate formulas, their affine parametrization (u,t,v,a,b), exact F=a(u−bv²)+u²+v³ and G=t(1+b²v)+uv+bv³−ab²v² identities, with independent SymPy substitutions. On H=1+b²v nonzero eliminate t, irreducible hypersurface F gives singular support u=v=a=0, t=0. On H=0, v≠0 and explicit inverse parametrization / exact Jacobian minor gives smoothness. At any b=b0, substitutions W=u−bv², U=a+u+bv², Z=v(1+b²v)^(1/3), B=b−b0 are formally invertible, and F=UW+Z³ identically, so completed local ring is A2 surface crossed with smooth 1-parameter line. Jacobian ideal (U,W,Z²) has transversal length two. Normal/rationality are standard for Du Val A2 singularity. These local results do not contradict global nonnormality.
